summary: The note covers the qualification stage for the 2020 AFC U-23 Championship. Of the 47 AFC member associations, 44 teams entered the competition. The host nation Thailand chose to take part in qualification even though it had already automatically qualified for the final tournament.
one_line: Overview of the qualifying stage for the 2020 AFC U-23 Championship, including the number of entrants and Thailand's participation.
key_facts: The 2020 AFC U-23 Championship qualification involved 44 teams.
44 of the 47 AFC member associations entered the competition.
Thailand was the final tournament hosts for the 2020 AFC U-23 Championship.
Thailand decided to participate in qualification.
Thailand had automatically qualified for the final tournament before deciding to take part in qualification.
The host nation's decision to enter qualification was made despite its automatic place in the final tournament.
